observations: Photo 0: close-up of a bare engine block with a casting/stamp reading '2GR' and a partial parts code, consistent with a Toyota 2GR-family V6 block.
Photo 0 shows only the block and a timing/accessory bracket area with some grime and oxidation; no intake manifold, wiring harness, alternator, or starter visible in this shot.

Photo 1 and Photo 2 show a row of multiple similar-looking engines sitting on wooden pallets/floor in what looks like a warehouse or container, each with black plastic intake manifold covers and various hoses attached.
Watermark 'NZJAPANESE AUTOS' / 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on all three photos, indicating a reused dealer photo set rather than necessarily a single specific unit.
No photos show the full engine from all sides, no wiring harness/ECU, no transmission, no oil pan or sump clearly, and no test/running footage.
No shipping labels, container markings, or paperwork visible to confirm origin.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a partial block/bracket area; photos 1-2 show engines with manifolds and hoses but no full 360-degree view confirming all ancillaries (wiring harness, ECU, starter, alternator, sensors) are present.
Photo 0 shows a '2GR' stamp cast/engraved into the block.
No shipping documents, container numbers, or origin markings visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (by virtue of being for sale)
claims.evidence: No compression test, no running video, no oil/coolant check shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not be the exact unit pictured (stock/warehouse photo reused for multiple listings)
risks.proof: A photo of the specific engine tagged with the seller's listing number or a video walk-around matching this exact unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used 2GR engine of unverified individual identity

risks.risk: Completeness (missing wiring harness, ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, intake/exhaust manifolds)
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos including front, rear, both sides, and top showing harness and ancillaries attached

risks.risk: Running condition / internal damage (knock, seized, cracked block, bad bearings)
risks.proof: Video of engine running/starting, or compression test results
Odometer photo from donor vehicle or auction sheet/import documentation

risks.risk: Origin claim (Belgium) cannot be confirmed, affecting assumed quality grade of import
risks.proof: Bill of lading, customs clearance paper, or container photo with engine tagged

risks.risk: Visible corrosion/grime on block (photo 0) may indicate water exposure or long storage
risks.proof: Clean close-up of cylinder bores, oil galleys, or compression test
risks.if_unproven: priced with deduction for possible internal corrosion

proof_requests: A video of this specific engine running or at least turning over with sound
Full walk-around photos (front, back, both sides, top) of the exact unit being sold
Close-up of wiring harness, ECU, starter, and alternator attached to the unit
Any import/customs paperwork or container photo showing origin
Compression test or oil/coolant condition photos
response.reason: The engine family (Toyota 2GR) is confirmed by the block stamp in photo 0, so it can be identified and priced, but completeness, working condition, and origin are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as an incomplete, non-verified-running 2GR long block.
